title: Fuselage — Fwd Cargo Door Surround — Replacement of the Corner Fittings by Titanium Items

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

ata.title: Fuselage Section 13 — Forward — Door Surround Structure

abstract: In-service replacement of the four aluminium-lithium corner fittings of the forward cargo door cut-out by machined titanium items, bringing delivered aircraft to the post-modification standard and deleting the repeat corner inspection.

sections.planning_reason: Delivered aircraft carry aluminium-lithium corner fittings at the forward cargo door cut-out. Under the revised high-density freight loading spectrum these fittings do not meet the design service goal and the substantiation imposes a repeat detailed visual inspection of the lower corner region every 3 000 flight cycles. Operators carrying that inspection report it as one of the most intrusive recurring tasks on the aircraft because it needs the hold lining out. This Service Bulletin removes the inspection by bringing the aircraft to the post-modification standard.
sections.description: The four fittings at the lower forward and lower aft corners of the cargo door cut-out are removed and replaced by machined titanium items with a thicker attachment flange and a larger load introduction radius. The frame web assembly is retained and re-drilled to the new fastener pattern, then re-fastened with titanium bolts and countersunk washers. Faying surfaces are sealed wet and the protective treatment is restored to the standard practice of ATA 51-20. The door, the door actuation installation and the latching mechanism are not touched.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access to the forward cargo compartment and remove the lower shell lining panels in zones 113 and 115. Remove the cargo floor panels local to the door cut-out. Confirm that the baseline inspection of Service Bulletin MRD-53-1008 has been done and that no open finding is recorded. Do the removal task AMM-M-53-21-13-000-001-A for the four fittings and retain the frame web assembly D5321003375416. Ream the fastener holes to the new pattern with the drill jig and do an eddy current inspection of every reamed hole. Do the installation task AMM-M-53-21-13-400-001-A with bolts AES495354-07 and washers AES963502K7 to the torque values in the accomplishment instructions. Apply sealant to the faying surfaces and restore the protective treatment. Install the cargo floor panels and the lining panels. Do the cargo door operational test and record the embodiment against the aircraft.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to MRD-42K1 and MRD-46K1 aircraft from MSN M00001 through M00300 that are still pre MOD-160142. Aircraft at or after the production cut-in already carry the titanium standard and must not be worked to this Service Bulletin. Freighter aircraft are not covered and are the subject of a separate assessment.
sections.material_note: Kit K5321-1012-01 contains the four titanium fittings, the fastener set, the sealant and the protective treatment consumables. Lead time is eighteen weeks from order. The removed aluminium-lithium fittings are not returnable and may be scrapped locally once the embodiment is recorded.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.

revision_history.reason: Eddy current inspection of the reamed holes made mandatory; torque values corrected in step 8; prerequisite inspection bulletin called out explicitly
